metadata.name: codementor-ai
metadata.description: AI-powered code review tool — pastes code, gets expert review via Google Gemini, saves history locally

architecture.framework: Angular 21 — standalone components only, zero NgModules

routing.note: withViewTransitions uses native browser View Transitions API for page navigation animations

architecture.http: HttpClient with withFetch() — used exclusively in GeminiService

state-management.approach: Angular Signals (signal, computed) + RxJS BehaviorSubject for streaming state
state-management.no-library: No NgRx, Akita, or external state library

architecture.persistence: localStorage — history (max 50 items), Gemini API key, theme preference

code-editor.loading-strategy: Custom script injection via document.createElement('script') pointing to assets/monaco/min/vs/loader.js — bypasses ngx-monaco-editor-v2 initialization despite the provider being registered

architecture.folder-structure: src/ index.html main.ts styles.scss ← imports variables, animations, base + Google Fonts styles/ _variables.scss ← ALL CSS custom properties + SCSS breakpoint mixins _animations.scss ← 16 keyframe definitions + utility classes _base.scss ← reset, typography, scrollbars, .btn, .badge, .input, .card, .glass utilities environments/ environment.ts environment.prod.ts app/ app.ts app.html app.routes.ts app.config.ts app.scss core/ services/ gemini.service.ts ← Gemini API + BehaviorSubject state machine + mock fallback review-history.service.ts ← localStorage CRUD + computed metrics theme.service.ts ← dark/light toggle via data-theme attribute features/ landing/ landing.component.ts ← data arrays only (features, testimonials, stats, codeDemo) landing.component.html landing.component.scss dashboard/ dashboard.component.ts dashboard.component.html dashboard.component.scss review/ review.component.ts ← orchestrates GeminiService + step animation timers review.component.html review.component.scss components/ code-editor/ code-editor.component.ts ← Monaco lifecycle + custom dark theme definition review-results/ review-results.component.ts ← IssueItemComponent declared inside same file history/ history.component.ts history.component.html history.component.scss settings/ settings.component.ts settings.component.html settings.component.scss layouts/ main-layout/ main-layout.component.ts ← sidebar + topbar inline template; ThemeService + HistoryService injected main-layout.component.scss models/ review.model.ts ← all TypeScript interfaces + CODE_SAMPLES + LANGUAGE_OPTIONS shared/ components/ diff-viewer/ diff-viewer.component.ts ← naive line-by-line diff algorithm + clipboard copy loading-timeline/ loading-timeline.component.ts review-card/ review-card.component.ts skeleton-loader/ skeleton-loader.component.ts

routing.shell: MainLayoutComponent wraps ALL routes — sidebar and topbar are always visible, including on /landing
routing.known-issue: Landing page renders inside the app shell (sidebar + topbar visible), which is unconventional for a marketing/landing page. A dedicated fullscreen layout shell for /landing would be a cleaner pattern.

component.name: MainLayoutComponent
component.description: Shell layout with fixed sidebar (240px), sticky topbar (60px), and router-outlet for page content. Sidebar collapses to slide-in drawer below 1024px via signal(sidebarOpen). ThemeService and ReviewHistoryService injected.

nav-groups.group: Dashboard, Review Code (with history badge count), History

topbar.left: Hamburger menu button (mobile only) + current page breadcrumb
topbar.right: "New Review" primary btn + theme toggle icon btn

component.name: LandingComponent
component.data: features[], testimonials[], stats[], codeDemo string — all pure data, no service calls

component.name: ReviewComponent
component.imports: CommonModule, FormsModule, CodeEditorComponent, ReviewResultsComponent, LoadingTimelineComponent, SkeletonLoaderComponent
component.state: code signal, language signal, timelineSteps signal, reviewState$ observable

component.name: CodeEditorComponent
component.description: Loads Monaco Editor via custom script injection. Defines codementor-dark theme with hardcoded hex colors. ResizeObserver for layout. Lifecycle: OnInit, AfterViewInit, OnChanges, OnDestroy.

component.name: ReviewResultsComponent
component.inputs: response: ReviewResponse, originalCode: string, language: string
component.grade-logic: computed from total issues + critical security count → A/B/C/D/F

component.name: IssueItemComponent
component.note: Declared in same file as ReviewResultsComponent — no separate file

component.name: DiffViewerComponent
component.inputs: original: string, refactored: string, language: string
component.description: Naive line-by-line diff (no LCS). Side-by-side panes. Clipboard copy via navigator.clipboard. ngOnChanges triggers recompute.

component.name: LoadingTimelineComponent
component.inputs: progress: number, currentStep: string, steps: TimelineStep[]
component.description: Animated progress bar with glow, step pills (pending/active/completed states)

component.name: SkeletonLoaderComponent
component.description: Shimmer skeleton — 3 preset layouts for review, card, metric

component.name: SettingsComponent
component.state: apiKey signal, apiKeySaved signal, apiKeyVisible signal
component.description: Gemini API key management (localStorage), theme toggle, clear history

section.name: Hero
section.layout: Full viewport (min-height: 100vh). Column on mobile, row on ≥1024px. padding: 120px 64px 80px desktop / 80px 16px 60px mobile.

background.element: 600×600px radial gradient rgba(124,58,237,0.18), top:-100px left:-200px, animation: orb-float-1 12s infinite
500×500px radial gradient rgba(6,182,212,0.12), bottom:-50px right:-100px, animation: orb-float-2 15s infinite
CSS grid pattern (48px cells) with radial mask fade

content-left.badge: Pill link: pulsing green dot + "New: Gemini 2.0 Flash Integration" + chevron arrow → /review
content-left.h1: "AI Code Reviews" (plain) + "That Actually Work" (gradient-text) font-size: clamp(36px, 5.5vw, 64px), font-weight: 900, letter-spacing: -0.04em
content-left.subtitle: 18px, text-secondary, max-width: 520px

actions.btn: Lightning bolt icon + "Start Reviewing — Free" → /review. box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(124,58,237,0.35)

content-right.header: macOS traffic-light dots + "example.ts" filename + warning badge "2 issues found"
content-right.pre: Static code block showing SQL injection before/after. Font: JetBrains Mono, 12px, color: #abb2bf

section.name: Features
section.layout: padding: 100px 64px. Flex column, items center. border-top.
section.header: section-eyebrow "Capabilities" + H2 "Everything you need for bulletproof code" + section-desc
section.card-hover: background: bg-card-hover, border-color: border-default, transform: translateY(-4px), shadow-md

section.name: HowItWorks
section.layout: padding: 100px 64px. Flex column. background: bg-secondary. border-top + border-bottom.
section.header: section-eyebrow "How It Works" + H2 "Review in 3 steps"
section.steps: Flex row (column on ≤768px). Connector line via ::before pseudo (gradient, height 1px, hidden on mobile).

section.name: Testimonials
section.card-decoration: Oversized decorative " via ::before, font-size:64px, Georgia serif, color: accent-primary, opacity 0.15

section.name: CTA
section.background: Single 700px orb: radial-gradient rgba(124,58,237,0.12), centered via transform: translate(-50%,-50%)

content.h2: "Start reviewing your code / right now, for free" (with gradient-text on second line)
content.p: No account required. No credit card. Paste your code...

footer.layout: Flex row (column on ≤768px), space-between. padding: 28px 64px. border-top. background: bg-secondary.
footer.nav: Dashboard / Review / History / Settings links (13px, text-muted)
footer.copy: Built with Angular 21 · Powered by Google Gemini (11px, text-muted)

colors.known-gap: ThemeService sets document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light') but there is NO :root[data-theme="light"] block in _variables.scss. The toggle button exists in the topbar but visually does nothing. To implement: add a :root[data-theme="light"] { } override block in _variables.scss.

animations.keyframes: fadeIn, fadeInUp, fadeInDown, slideInLeft, slideInRight, scaleIn, shimmer, pulse, spin, gradientShift, float, glow, typing, blink, progressFill, dotBounce, ripple, revealLine, orb-float-1, orb-float-2, scanline
animations.known-gap: No @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) wrapper exists anywhere. orb-float-1/2, gradientShift, glow all run infinitely with no opt-out.
Every .gradient-text element runs gradientShift 4s ease infinite. On a page with many headings this runs many simultaneous animations.

utility.name: .gradient-border
utility.desc: pseudo-element gradient border via mask technique

utility.name: .input
utility.desc: glass background, accent focus ring, custom select arrow

utility.name: .empty-state
utility.desc: centered flex column for zero-data states

monaco-theme.name: codementor-dark
monaco-theme.note: Hardcoded hex values — NOT using CSS custom properties. Changing _variables.scss will NOT update Monaco.

service.name: GeminiService
service.state: BehaviorSubject<ReviewState> with status: idle|loading|streaming|complete|error + progress (0–100) + currentStep string
service.api-body: { contents: [{ parts: [{ text: prompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.4, maxOutputTokens: 4096 } }
service.mock-fallback: If no API key: mockReview() fires 6 setTimeout steps at 400/900/1500/2100/2700/3200ms, resolves after 3600ms via timer()
service.prompt-schema: Returns JSON: { summary, bugs[], performance[], security[], refactoredCode } — each issue has { title, description, severity: critical|high|medium|low, line? }
service.error-handling: Parses err?.error?.error?.message or err.message; on JSON parse fail falls back to buildMockResponse()

service.name: ReviewHistoryService
service.metrics: totalReviews, bugsFound, securityIssues, performanceSuggestions — all derived via reduce
service.code-snippet-truncation: First 200 chars of code stored in history item

service.name: ThemeService
service.signal: _theme: signal<Theme> initialized from localStorage 'theme' key, defaults to 'dark'
service.mechanism: Sets document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme) — no light theme CSS exists yet

models.interface: summary: string, bugs: ReviewIssue[], performance: ReviewIssue[], security: ReviewIssue[], refactoredCode: string
title: string, description: string, severity: 'critical'|'high'|'medium'|'low', line?: number
id: string, timestamp: ISO string, language, summary, codeSnippet (200 chars), response: ReviewResponse
status: 'idle'|'loading'|'streaming'|'complete'|'error', progress: number, currentStep: string, response: ReviewResponse|null, error: string|null
models.constant: Array of { value, label, monacoLang } — 7 entries
Record<SupportedLanguage, string> — intentionally vulnerable sample code per language for demo purposes

safe-refactor-boundaries.rule: These files contain business logic. Visual CSS changes inside their styles are safe. TypeScript logic, @Input/@Output, template bindings, and class name bindings in [class]=... must NOT be changed.
safe-refactor-boundaries.do-not-touch-logic: API call chain, BehaviorSubject state machine, prompt template, JSON response parser, mock review timing (hardcoded delays coupled to ReviewComponent step animation)
localStorage schema (key: codementor_history), computed metrics, 50-item cap. Breaking changes propagate to Dashboard and History.
The data-theme attribute mechanism is the hook for any future light-mode CSS. Do not change the attribute name or storage key.

Monaco lifecycle (OnInit, AfterViewInit, OnChanges, OnDestroy), custom theme definition (hardcoded hex), ResizeObserver, script-injection loader path (assets/monaco/min/vs/loader.js), editor option object. Very fragile — any structural change risks breaking the editor.
computeDiff() algorithm (naive line-by-line), copyRefactored() clipboard logic, ngOnChanges trigger pattern.
Step animation delays [400, 900, 1500, 2100, 2700, 3200] are hardcoded and MUST match GeminiService mock step delays exactly. Do not reorder or add steps.
Grade calculation (get grade()), activeTab signal, tab IDs used in aria-controls. IssueItemComponent is declared inside this same file — do not split without updating imports.
All TypeScript types, CODE_SAMPLES, LANGUAGE_OPTIONS — touched by 8+ components.
provideMonacoEditor({ baseUrl: './assets/monaco' }) — path must match deployed assets.
Lazy-load import paths. Change URL paths only if intentional.

safe-to-edit-css-only.note: Inline styles[] arrays in shared components are also safe to edit (CSS block only — not [class] bindings in templates)

patterns-in-use.pattern: role attributes: main, navigation, banner, contentinfo, region, list, listitem, article, tablist, tab, tabpanel, progressbar, status, img
aria-label on all interactive elements and landmark regions
aria-current="page" on active sidebar nav items
aria-live="polite" on LoadingTimeline and editor stats
aria-controls + aria-selected on tab interface in ReviewResults
.sr-only utility class used for screen-reader-only labels
keydown.enter + keydown.space on ReviewCardComponent for keyboard activation
tabindex="-1" on main content element for skip-link target
aria-hidden="true" on all decorative SVG icons and background elements

gaps.gap: No skip-to-content link visible in the HTML
No prefers-reduced-motion handling for any animation
Landing page: code demo block role="img" with aria-label but the static code block has no line-by-line accessibility

gap.title: Light mode toggle is visually inert
gap.detail: ThemeService sets data-theme="light" on html element. No :root[data-theme="light"] CSS block exists anywhere. The theme button in the topbar does nothing visually.

gap.title: Landing page is inside the app shell
gap.detail: The /landing route renders inside MainLayoutComponent. The sidebar and topbar (240px + 60px) are visible on the marketing landing page, which consumes screen real estate and looks unconventional.
gap.fix: Create a FullscreenLayoutComponent with no sidebar/topbar and assign it as the shell for /landing in app.routes.ts

gap.title: No prefers-reduced-motion media queries
gap.detail: orb-float-1, orb-float-2, gradientShift, glow, pulse, float, spin all run infinitely. No @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) wrappers exist anywhere in the codebase.
gap.fix: Wrap continuous animations in _animations.scss with @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .animate-* { animation: none } }

gap.title: gradientShift runs on every .gradient-text element simultaneously
gap.detail: The landing page alone has ~5 .gradient-text instances. Each runs gradientShift 4s infinite — a composite-layer animation on text. On lower-end devices this can cause jank.
gap.fix: Change to animation-iteration-count: 1 with animation-fill-mode: forwards, or use animation: none and a static gradient on the text.

gap.title: Monaco editor bypasses ngx-monaco-editor-v2 initialization
gap.detail: CodeEditorComponent injects its own script tag loading assets/monaco/min/vs/loader.js. ngx-monaco-editor-v2 is registered via provideMonacoEditor() in app.config.ts but its initialization is never used. The package is listed in dependencies but effectively unused for loading.

gap.title: currentPageLabel uses window.location.pathname directly
gap.detail: MainLayoutComponent.get currentPageLabel() reads window.location.pathname. Not reactive — won't update on route changes without a full CD cycle. Should use ActivatedRoute or Router.events.

gap.title: marked library may be unused
gap.detail: marked@18.0.5 is in dependencies but no import of it is visible in the scanned TypeScript files. ReviewResults renders response.summary as plain text {{ response.summary }}, not as HTML. Either it's unused or called in a file not yet read (e.g., history component detail view).

redesign-strategy.principle: All visual changes should be CSS-only unless explicitly noted. The design token system in _variables.scss is the single source of truth — retheme there first, everything else follows.
redesign-strategy.phase: Replace CSS custom property values to change the entire palette. The gradient-brand and gradient-brand-text tokens drive: sidebar active states, step numbers, badge pills, CTA button, all .gradient-text instances, focus rings, scrollbar thumbs, Monaco cursor/selection. Changing these 2 tokens cascades across the whole app.

Add :root[data-theme="light"] block with overridden values. The ThemeService hook (data-theme attribute) is already in place. Monaco theme (codementor-dark) will need a separate light variant defined in CodeEditorComponent — those colors are hardcoded.
Create FullscreenLayoutComponent (router-outlet only, no sidebar/topbar). Assign it to /landing. LandingComponent itself is untouched. This is a routing-level change only.

Safe targets within the landing SCSS: - Hero: adjust orb colors/opacity, grid pattern density, add third orb for depth - Features grid: add gradient-border utility or gradient card hover instead of flat border - How It Works: replace pseudo-element connector line with a thicker SVG arrow or animated path - Testimonials: add shadow-glow on hover for accent depth - CTA: add second blurred orb in complementary brand color, increase title size - Footer: increase padding, add subtle gradient fade at top border

- Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) wrappers for all infinite animations - Change gradientShift on .gradient-text to iteration-count: 1 or remove loop - Add will-change: transform to orb elements for GPU compositing hint - Ensure entrance animations (fadeInUp) on feat-card respect stagger delays correctly
redesign-strategy.caution: The Monaco editor background (#0c0c1d) matches --bg-secondary by coincidence of hardcoded value. If you change --bg-secondary you must also update the 'editor.background' color inside CodeEditorComponent.initEditor() manually — it does NOT reference CSS variables.

MainLayoutComponent and DashboardComponent use DomSanitizer to inject SVG icons as innerHTML. If you replace icons with a different approach (e.g., ng-icons, direct SVG components), remove the bypassSecurityTrustHtml calls and the DomSanitizer injection.
